outcome: Risk of hospitalization due to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) bronchiolitis
cohort: All children born at term (≥37 weeks of gestation) without congenital malformations in Finland between 1996 and 2015
finding: Transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) diagnosis after birth was associated with an increased risk of RSV hospitalization during the first year of life.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of delivery was a factor that was adjusted for when analyzing the association between transient tachypnea of the newborn and risk of RSV hospitalization.
